title: Login & Biometric Onboarding
text: Six frames covering first-run login, biometric opt-in, passcode fallback, and the trusted-device consent sheet added in v2.4. The biometric opt-in frame is the only screen that may show two primary buttons.

title: Payment Confirmation Screen
text: Frames for the payment confirmation screen: recipient summary, fee breakdown expanded, confirm button enabled state, and the post-confirm receipt. The confirm button uses the shared UI kit primary button component.

title: Card Management — Freeze Card Toggle
text: The card management screen. Includes the freeze card toggle in both on and off states, the report-lost confirmation dialog, and the virtual card creation sheet. The freeze card toggle is the component referenced by PF-121 for the missing accessibility label.

title: Transaction History — Filters and Export
text: Transaction history list, filter drawer with date range and category, empty state, and the export sheet offering CSV and PDF. The list uses pagination at 50 rows per page.
